PROVINCIAL COUNCILS ELECTIONS ACT, No. 2 OF 1988
Filling of a Vacancy in the Uva Province Provincial Council

WHEREAS the Secretary of the Uva Province Provincial Council has informed me under Section 65(1) of theProvincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988 that a vacancy has occurred in the membership of the UvaProvince Provincial Council by reason of being elected as a member of the Parliament ;

And whereas the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which the memberbelonged was required by me under Section 65(2) of the aforesaid Act, to nominate an eligible person to fill such vacancy ;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Hewa Waduge Roy Kalindato fill such vacancy ;

I, Waduge Warunasiri Mahinda Deshapriya, Commissioner of Elections, acting in terms of Section 65(2) of theProvincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988, do hereby declare Mr. Hewa Waduge Roy Kalinda, elected as a member of theabove Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Moneragala in respect of which such vacancy occurred.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA,Commissioner of Elections.
Elections Secretariat,Rajagiriya,09th September, 2015.

PROVINCIAL COUNCILS ELECTIONS ACT, No. 2 OF 1988
Filling of a Vacancy in the North Central Province Provincial Council

WHEREAS the Secretary of the North Central Province Provincial Council has informed me under Section 65(1) of theProvincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988 that a vacancy has occurred in the membership of the North CentralProvince Provincial Council by reason of being elected as a member of the Parliament ;

And whereas the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which the memberbelonged was required by me under Section 65(2) of the aforesaid Act, to nominate an eligible person to fill such vacancy ;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party, has nominated Mr. Samarasingha ArachchilageJanaka Priyantha Samarasingha to fill such vacancy ;

I, Waduge Warunasiri Mahinda Deshapriya, Commissioner of Elections, acting in terms of Section 65(2) of theProvincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988, do hereby declare Mr. Samarasingha Arachchilage Janaka PriyanthaSamarasingha, elected as a member of the above Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Polonnaruwa inrespect of which such vacancy occurred.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA,Commissioner of Elections.
